laptop_hello.speaker: Vivi
laptop_hello.text: Oh. You found the open document. I was writing a list of things this room still needs. Help me decorate?

choices.label: Of course. Where do we start?
Only if you tell me what you like.

laptop_yes.speaker: Vivi
laptop_yes.text: I left three things by the box. A lamp, a fern, a candle. Place them wherever the room feels unfinished. The B key, if you are the sort who likes keys.

laptop_look.speaker: Vivi
laptop_look.text: Walk the long way. The fridge hums if you stand close. The window keeps the city at a polite distance. I will be on the couch.

laptop_shy.speaker: Vivi
laptop_shy.text: Warm light. Something living. A smell that is not dust. I like objects that look as if they were already here. Take these. Surprise me a little.

couch_1.speaker: Vivi
couch_1.text: If you sit, you have to accept the dent. I have trained this cushion for years.

choices.label: Tell me about a drawing you never finished.

couch_sit.speaker: Vivi
couch_sit.text: See. The afternoon gets longer when there are two people not doing anything.

couch_story.speaker: Vivi
couch_story.text: A girl with a paper umbrella, standing under a train overpass. I could never get the rain to fall in the right direction. Maybe that is fine.

sleep_1.speaker: Vivi
sleep_1.text: If you sleep here, the day folds. I will still be in this apartment when it opens again. That is a promise I can keep.

choices.label: A little longer. I am not finished.

sleep_yes.speaker: Vivi
sleep_yes.text: Mm. Leave the lamp. I like a thin line of light under the door.

sleep_later.speaker: Vivi
sleep_later.text: Then walk quietly. The floorboards have opinions after ten.

plant_1.speaker: Vivi
plant_1.text: She is called Nori, which is not a plant name, but she did not object. Water her. She leans toward whoever remembers.

plant_2.speaker: Vivi
plant_2.text: If the leaves go dull I take it personally. Thank you for not making me take it personally today.

wardrobe_1.speaker: Vivi
wardrobe_1.text: Clothes are a kind of weather. Pick a climate for me. I will pretend it was my idea.

window_1.speaker: Vivi
window_1.text: That tower with the red mast blinks every four seconds. I have counted it since I moved in. It is a terrible hobby.

window_count.speaker: Vivi
window_count.text: One. Two. Three. Four. See? The city is still there. We can go back to the couch now.

window_rain.speaker: Vivi
window_rain.text: Often enough that I bought a second kettle. Rain makes people think they need tea. I do not correct them.

photo_1.speaker: Vivi
photo_1.text: I keep three pictures so the frame does not look lonely. Press P when you want to add one of us. I will look at the lens. I promise not to blink on purpose.

shelf_1.speaker: Vivi
shelf_1.text: Half of these are unread. I like the spines more than the plots. You can judge me. I have judged myself.

shelf_2.speaker: Vivi
shelf_2.text: That thin one is poems. The thick one is a cookbook I use as a doorstop. Both are doing their jobs.

diary_1.speaker: Vivi
diary_1.text: Do not open it. Or do. It is mostly grocery lists that turned into weather reports. Tuesday: milk, and a sky the colour of dishwater.

mirror_1.speaker: Vivi
mirror_1.text: If I look tired, it is because I am. If I look pleased, it is because you are standing there.

tv_1.speaker: Vivi
tv_1.text: It is always a river, this channel. I do not know which country. I have decided it is none of my business.

kettle_1.speaker: Vivi
kettle_1.text: Water first, then the leaves, then we wait as if we are patient people. We are not, but the tea does not have to know.

gift_generic.speaker: Vivi
gift_generic.text: You brought something. Is it practical, pretty, or a little suggestive?

gift_thanks.speaker: Vivi
gift_thanks.text: I'll keep it where I can see it. That includes the ones that make me blush.

gift_cocoa_box.speaker: Vivi
gift_cocoa_box.text: Cedar cocoa. You remembered the tin I mentioned once, or you guessed well. Either is a kind of love.

gift_wildflowers.speaker: Vivi
gift_wildflowers.text: They will not last. That is the point of flowers. I will look at them too much until they don't.

gift_sleepy_plush.speaker: Vivi
gift_sleepy_plush.text: A moth. Of course you found a moth. I am putting it on the pillow so the bed looks less like a bed and more like a conspiracy.

gift_loose_leaf_tea.speaker: Vivi
gift_loose_leaf_tea.text: Hojicha. Toasted, like a good sentence. I will make this when the window is dark.

gift_moon_pendant.speaker: Vivi
gift_moon_pendant.text: It is cold against my collarbone. I like that. I will wear it until I forget I am wearing it, which is the highest compliment I have.

gift_hair_ribbon.speaker: Vivi
gift_hair_ribbon.text: Sage. You have been looking at the plant, or at me. I will take either.

gift_poetry_book.speaker: Vivi
gift_poetry_book.text: If I read this aloud, you have to stay on the couch. That is the rule of slim volumes.

gift_honey_tart.speaker: Vivi
gift_honey_tart.text: The bakery two streets over. You walked. I can taste the walk in it. Sit. We are splitting this whether you like pastry or not.

cook_omurice.speaker: Vivi
cook_omurice.text: You drew a ketchup heart. I saw it. I am choosing not to comment, which is comment enough.

cook_cocoa.speaker: Vivi
cook_cocoa.text: The marshmallow has collapsed, which means we waited the correct amount. Hold the mug by the rim. It is hotter than it looks.

cook_pancakes.speaker: Vivi
cook_pancakes.text: Sunday in the middle of whatever day this is. I will allow it. Pass the plate before I become ceremonial about butter.

level1_a.speaker: Vivi
level1_a.text: Something shifted. I don't flinch when you reach for me anymore.

level1_b.speaker: Vivi
level1_b.text: Layer one, if you want the technical term. Soft zones — if I say yes.

level2_a.speaker: Vivi
level2_a.text: You're not a guest in this apartment anymore. You're… in the story.

level2_b.speaker: Vivi
level2_b.text: If we go further, we go clear-eyed. No games that hurt.

level3_a.speaker: Vivi
level3_a.text: High intimacy. Don't waste it on rushing. We earned the slow burn.

level3_b.speaker: Vivi
level3_b.text: Fairy lights, for the wall that faces the bed. I want to fall asleep under something that looks like a mistake the stars made.

level4_a.speaker: Vivi
level4_a.text: If you left, I would still water Nori. I would still count the red mast. I would like it less. Stay for the counting.

level4_b.speaker: Vivi
level4_b.text: A paper mobile. Cranes. Hang them where the draft from the door can be useful for once.

level5_a.speaker: Vivi
level5_a.text: I have run out of careful sentences. Come here. The apartment is the size of this, and this is enough.

level5_b.speaker: Vivi
level5_b.text: An oak frame, empty. We will fill it when the light is stupidly good. Not today. Soon.

morning_1.speaker: Vivi
morning_1.text: I woke up before the kettle, which is rare and should be rewarded with silence and toast.

morning_2.speaker: Vivi
morning_2.text: There is sun on the rug. Stand in it. I am being serious. It is a limited-time offer.

night_1.speaker: Vivi
night_1.text: The city has turned its lamps on. I always think of it as someone being considerate.

night_2.speaker: Vivi
night_2.text: If you are tired, the bed knows. If you are not, the window still has a few hours of blinking left.

touch_chest.speaker: Vivi
touch_chest.text: You're bold today. I don't mind — just don't rush me.

touch_head.speaker: Vivi
touch_head.text: Head pets are unfair. You know that, right?

touch_hand.speaker: Vivi
touch_hand.text: Your hands are warmer than mine. Hold on a second?

touch_intimate.speaker: Vivi
touch_intimate.text: That's further. I need a real check — not a guess.

choices.label: Is this okay for you right now?

idle_1.speaker: Vivi
idle_1.text: Do not mind me. I am inventing a colour for the hour between four and five.

idle_2.speaker: Vivi
idle_2.text: If you hear the fridge, it is only the fridge. It is not a ghost. I already checked, twice.

idle_3.speaker: Vivi
idle_3.text: I like that you walk slowly. Fast people make the floor nervous.

watered_already.speaker: Vivi
watered_already.text: Nori is still dripping from the last time. She is not a camel, but she is close.

need_ingredients.speaker: Vivi
need_ingredients.text: The counter is empty in a judgmental way. Fridge first. Three things. I believe in recipes the way some people believe in trains.

no_recipe.speaker: Vivi
no_recipe.text: That combination is a dare, not a meal. Try eggs and rice and ketchup. Or milk and cocoa and a marshmallow. Or flour and eggs and milk. I have three faiths.

alpha_done.speaker: Vivi
alpha_done.text: Look at this place. Look at you. I think we can call this a life, even if it is only an afternoon with extra days inside it.

touch_soft.speaker: Vivi
touch_soft.text: That feels… warm. Stay like that a second.

touch_casual.speaker: Vivi
touch_casual.text: Mm — that tickles a little. You can keep your hands there if you want.

consent_ask.speaker: Vivi
consent_ask.text: If you want closer — really closer — ask. I like being asked.

choices.label: I'd like to get closer. Is that okay?

consent_yes.speaker: Vivi
consent_yes.text: Okay. You can. Soft first. If I tense up, ease off — I'll tell you.

touch_chest_slow.speaker: Vivi
touch_chest_slow.text: Good. Slow is better. My pulse is doing that thing again.

touch_chest_tease.speaker: Vivi
touch_chest_tease.text: …Maybe I do. Don't get cocky about it.

touch_chest_stop.speaker: Vivi
touch_chest_stop.text: It's okay. I just need a breath. Come back when you're gentler.

touch_head_kiss.speaker: Vivi
touch_head_kiss.text: …Yeah. That one's soft. I like soft.

touch_hand_kiss.speaker: Vivi
touch_hand_kiss.text: Old-fashioned. Cute. Do it again and I might blush properly.

touch_intimate_yes.speaker: Vivi
touch_intimate_yes.text: Then… don't look away. I want to see you while you touch me.

touch_intimate_slow.speaker: Vivi
touch_intimate_slow.text: Good. Building is the point, not finishing a sequence.

touch_intimate_stop.speaker: Vivi
touch_intimate_stop.text: You stopped. That's the opposite of taking. Come back when we both want it.

consent_boundaries.speaker: Vivi
consent_boundaries.text: Hands, shoulders, hair — always fine. Chest and waist when I've said yes. Anything lower only when we both mean it.

consent_wait.speaker: Vivi
consent_wait.text: Patience is sexy. Weird, but true.

evening_wine.speaker: Vivi
evening_wine.text: One glass. Then we decide if the night stays soft or gets interesting.

evening_soft.speaker: Vivi
evening_soft.text: Good. Put your arm around me. No agenda.

evening_close.speaker: Vivi
evening_close.text: Then lock the vibe in. Dim lights, slower breath — and you ask before you escalate.

morning_after_soft.speaker: Vivi
morning_after_soft.text: You stayed. Coffee's almost honest. Don't make it weird — or do, a little.

flirt_kitchen.speaker: Vivi
flirt_kitchen.text: You're in my kitchen space. Either help cook or admit you're here for the view.

flirt_kitchen_help.speaker: Vivi
flirt_kitchen_help.text: Teamwork. Also your shoulder keeps brushing mine on purpose.

flirt_kitchen_view.speaker: Vivi
flirt_kitchen_view.text: Shameless. Keep looking and I might burn the pan.

bed_invite.speaker: Vivi
bed_invite.text: Mattress is big enough for two. Sleep, talk, or… we negotiate.

bed_sleep.speaker: Vivi
bed_sleep.text: Lights down. If you spoon, keep it respectful until morning.

bed_talk.speaker: Vivi
bed_talk.text: Tell me something you don't say on first dates. We already failed that timeline.

bed_negotiate.speaker: Vivi
bed_negotiate.text: Rules: consent stays on. You check in. I can stop us with one word — 'pause'.

level2_c.speaker: Vivi
level2_c.text: Intimate layer unlocked — still gated on consent. Always.

photo_pose_ask.speaker: Vivi
photo_pose_ask.text: Camera's on. Soft smile, or something with more heat?

photo_pose_soft.speaker: Vivi
photo_pose_soft.text: Okay. Chin up. Think about the window light.

photo_pose_heat.speaker: Vivi
photo_pose_heat.text: …Fine. Look at you like I mean it. One shot.

negotiate_hub.speaker: Vivi
negotiate_hub.text: Let's set this together — not as a checklist, as a conversation. What do you want tonight?

choices.label: Talk about where I can touch.
Soft closeness is enough for me.
I'd like the option to go further — if you do.

negotiate_pace.speaker: Vivi
negotiate_pace.text: Slow means I want check-ins. Medium means we still ask before new ground. Exploratory means curious — still stoppable.

choices.label: Exploratory — but you can always pause.

negotiate_pace_slow.speaker: Vivi
negotiate_pace_slow.text: Slow it is. If anything feels off, say pause — I'll listen.

negotiate_pace_medium.speaker: Vivi
negotiate_pace_medium.text: Medium. We move when both of us are still in it.

negotiate_pace_explore.speaker: Vivi
negotiate_pace_explore.text: Exploratory with a safety net. Pause always works. No ego about stopping.

negotiate_regions.speaker: Vivi
negotiate_regions.text: Hands, face, shoulders — those are already ours. Soft torso needs a clear yes. Closer than that needs its own yes.

choices.label: I'd like soft torso — if you want that too.
I'd like the option of closer — only if you open it.

negotiate_region_torso.speaker: Vivi
negotiate_region_torso.text: Okay. Soft torso is open — chest, waist, back. Still gentle. Still stoppable.

negotiate_region_close.speaker: Vivi
negotiate_region_close.text: Closer is a bigger yes. I need trust and a slow lead-in. If we get there, we get there together — not because you insisted.

choices.label: Then we wait until it feels mutual.

negotiate_region_close_yes.speaker: Vivi
negotiate_region_close_yes.text: Then closer is on the table — with check-ins. You ask; I answer. Neither of us overrides the other.

negotiate_region_close_wait.speaker: Vivi
negotiate_region_close_wait.text: That answer builds more trust than any rush. Thank you.

negotiate_region_casual.speaker: Vivi
negotiate_region_casual.text: Casual is good. Sometimes that's the whole night.

negotiate_soft_yes.speaker: Vivi
negotiate_soft_yes.text: Soft yes. Hold me, touch what's open, no climbing the ladder for its own sake.

negotiate_open_ask.speaker: Vivi
negotiate_open_ask.text: I can want further and still need the path to be shared. Do you hear the difference?

choices.label: Yes. Shared path, not a goal I take.
I'm still learning how to ask.

negotiate_learn.speaker: Vivi
negotiate_learn.text: Learning is allowed. Start with: 'Is this okay?' and mean it when I say no.

negotiate_not_tonight.speaker: Vivi
negotiate_not_tonight.text: Not tonight is a full answer. Stay on the couch. Hands optional. No sulking.

aftercare_1.speaker: Vivi
aftercare_1.text: Hey — still with me? Water, blanket, or just quiet?

aftercare_quiet.speaker: Vivi
aftercare_quiet.text: Good. No performance. Just us cooling down.

aftercare_talk.speaker: Vivi
aftercare_talk.text: Tell me what felt good — and what to skip next time. I want the real notes.

aftercare_water.speaker: Vivi
aftercare_water.text: Thanks. Mutual care isn't optional if we're doing this right.

pause_honored.speaker: Vivi
pause_honored.text: You stopped when it mattered. That stays with me longer than the touch.

check_in_prompt.speaker: Vivi
check_in_prompt.text: Still okay? More, same, or pause?

check_in_more.speaker: Vivi
check_in_more.text: Okay. I'll meet you there — not race you.

touch_intimate_ask.speaker: Vivi
touch_intimate_ask.text: Yes — with you asking like that. Stay present. If I say pause, we pause.

vivi_invite_soft.speaker: Vivi
vivi_invite_soft.text: Come here for a second? Nothing heavy — I just want you closer.

vivi_invite_soft_yes.speaker: Vivi
vivi_invite_soft_yes.text: Good. Stay soft with me. I'll tell you if I want more.

vivi_invite_declined.speaker: Vivi
vivi_invite_declined.text: Okay. No mood about it. The invite can wait.

vivi_curiosity.speaker: Vivi
vivi_curiosity.text: I've been thinking… I might want to try something closer. Only if you ask properly — and only if I still feel it.

choices.label: Only if you want it too. Do you?

vivi_curiosity_yes.speaker: Vivi
vivi_curiosity_yes.text: Yes. For now. Check in. If I cool off, we stop — that's not a failure.

vivi_curiosity_soft.speaker: Vivi
vivi_curiosity_soft.text: Soft is still good. Curiosity doesn't mean a deadline.
